nodes.title: Spatial LookDev Dynamic Synthesized Pipeline
widgets_values:
Spatial LookDev 2-Stage Dynamic Pipeline (Shot 0085)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Stage 1 (SDXL Base): 7-Part Regional conditioning with per-piece independent Positive & Negative prompts.
  - Image-active pieces route through IP-Adapter regional conditioning.
  - Text-only pieces route through native ConditioningSetMask (Zero VRAM, fast & native).
  - Balanced Binary Tree combining for all positive & negative conditionings.
• Stage 2 (FLUX.1-dev LoRA Refiner): Apple Minimal Craft CMF refinement (Denoise: 0.48).
